svg.title: Separate controlled messages from current report data
svg.desc: Application task and optional demonstration are controlled inputs. The current report is JSON-escaped into one user message. With the example there are four messages: system task, user example, assistant example answer, user current report. Without the example there are two. The application role structure is preserved, while model obedience still needs evaluation.

g.text: Construct roles explicitly; bind the report as data
No report text becomes an extra role.
Two messages without the example; four with it. No model is run by assembly.
Preserved application structure does not guarantee that an LLM ignores hostile text.
